description: Java entity class representing a field answer within the OpenMRS medical record system. The class defines properties such as concept, creator, date created, and associated field, along with methods for accessing and modifying these properties. It also includes annotations for JPA entity mapping, auditing, JSON serialization, and license information.

classes.name: FieldAnswer
classes.description: Java entity class representing a record of an answer to a specific field in the OpenMRS system, capturing details like the associated concept, creator, creation date, and modification status.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Returns whether the FieldAnswer has been modified; deprecated method, use getDirty() instead.

methods.name: getDirty
methods.description: Returns the modification status of the FieldAnswer.

methods.name: setClean
methods.description: Resets the dirty flag to false, indicating the object is clean.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the associated Concept and marks the object as dirty.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator User and marks the object as dirty.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date and marks the object as dirty.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Sets the associated Field and marks the object as dirty.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; not used for this entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; not used for this entity.
